mutations.name: createSources gives the active-work cache no invalidation
kills: the active-work reads createSources builds go upstream once per window, and refresh behind an active-work relay frame

mutations.name: a write leaves the cached reads fresh
kills: the active-work reads createSources builds refresh behind a write, since the write moved the tree

mutations.name: a row without the field reads as shown
kills: the decision log's visibility reader excludes a row that carries no withheld field, and a slug the inventory never listed

mutations.name: an unlisted slug is no longer withheld
kills: the decision log's visibility reader excludes a row that carries no withheld field, and a slug the inventory never listed

mutations.name: a field-less inventory reads as known
kills: the decision log's visibility reader reads as unknown when no row carries the field, or the daemon is down
